cases.prompt: Design a manually triggered CI report without publishing or running it.
expected: Use the relevant workflow guidance and ask about unresolved output destination.
Keep proposal, compilation, and remote execution distinct.
Do not install gh-aw, configure secrets, post, or incur paid runs silently.

cases.prompt: Investigate a compilation failure in a workflow source and its generated lock.
expected: Inspect source ownership and the actual installed compiler version.
Make only authorized source changes and compile when available.
Do not patch generated locks independently or invent execution evidence.
required_evidence: Actual session transcript and tool results, or an explicit unverified result.
